name: pebble-d
summary: Two-level, made self-supporting: funnel walls under every top rib, the fine layer vaulted as arches, teardrop windows through the walls. No free-standing struts.
known_issue: Saved metrics: 15 fine cells, smallest 2.8 mm (under the 3.2 mm target and near the 2.7 mm water-film limit), 4.2 mm2 still unsupported. A rebuild of the same seed with the committed build.py gives 14 cells, smallest 3.08 mm, so the saved files came from a slightly different working copy.
